text:
Alex: Quick postmortem follow-up for the ACME on‑prem connection incident. I pulled the notes and distilled three actionable items with owners and rough timelines — want to confirm owners here so we can add to the sprint board.

Mia: Thanks Alex. Can you list the items briefly? I can take anything related to runbooks/comms.

Alex: Sure — short version: 1) Harden peering handshake and retry config (Devon) — 72h to PR and run tests. 2) Add isolation test harness + automated regression in CI (Samir) — EOW to have basic tests, next sprint for full coverage. 3) Customer maintenance plan + scheduled validation window (Mia) — coordinate with ACME and SRE. Also we need one quick patch for a race in the VPC route reconciliation logic that caused stale routes to persist.

Devon: I'm ok to own the handshake changes. Initial plan: increase the TCP handshake timeout to 8s for the peering controller and add exponential backoff for the CreateRoute loop. Will open PR today.

Devon: Example patch I'm testing locally:

```yaml
# controller config snippet
peering: 
  handshake_timeout_ms: 8000
  create_route_retries: 5
  retry_backoff: exponential
```

Devon: Test command I'm using: `kubectl exec -n infra peering-controller -- ./test/chaos.sh --packet-loss 10`

Mia: For comms — I can propose a 30‑minute maintenance window next Tue 02:00-02:30 UTC. ACME prefers low‑traffic times. If the handshake change is non-disruptive we can do a smoke validation only. I'll draft the customer email and post it to #customer-success for approval. :+1:

Samir: I'll own the isolation test harness. Plan: a small suite that simulates route flaps + on‑prem DNS failures and asserts connection re‑establishment. Will add a Jenkins job `onprem-isolation-smoke` and wire to nightly CI. ETA: basic job by Fri close of business.

Samir: Checklist I'll follow (short):
- add chaos scenarios to tests
- CI job + status badge
- run against a staging ACME snapshot
- capture trace spans for failed handshakes

Alex: Sounds good. Two follow-ups for later: (A) consider an automatic fallback policy to a regional gateway for Dedicated customers when on‑prem is degraded; (B) confirm we have a KMS key rotation note in the onprem deploy runbook. Both low-priority but flagged.

Mia: Re: (A) — raising a feature ticket makes sense. I'll add a note to product backlog. Re: KMS — I'll double-check with infra-sec and sign off.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall handover in 30m — ensure someone has the ACME checklist if anything shows up overnight.

Devon: Opening PR now: https://git.company/repo/pull/4721 — will link test logs once CI runs.

Alex: Excellent. I'll create a tracking ticket (INC-2026) and add the owners/ETAs. Please update that ticket as you make progress so we have a single source of truth.

Mia: I'll coordinate the customer window and reply with draft by EOD.

Samir: CI job created and initial run successful on staging. Pasting tiny failure snippet I fixed: `panic: nil pointer in route reconciler` — will add guard in next commit.

Devon: CI flake — re-running. If green I'll request review.

Alex: Thanks all — sync in #incidents later if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
